purpose: Current-source refresh while the Lumen v519 v1 x1 lane completed in the Browser route.

sources.label: OpenAI Codex changelog
sources.observed_takeaway: Recent Codex app updates improve Browser developer-mode recovery, browser speed, composer visibility, Windows attachment support, plugin surfacing, and active-goal usability.

sources.label: OpenAI Codex CLI 0.139.0 GitHub release
sources.observed_takeaway: CLI 0.139.0 adds code-mode standalone web search, richer tool schema preservation, redacted doctor environment reporting, marketplace source visibility, and stricter sandbox/network consistency.

sources.label: Model Context Protocol introduction
sources.observed_takeaway: MCP frames tool and data access as standardized external-system connections, supporting explicit route-family contracts for the GHC multiplex lane design.

sources.label: OWASP Agentic AI threats and mitigations
sources.observed_takeaway: Agentic systems require threat-model-based governance, least privilege, explicit permission boundaries, and mitigation discipline.

applied_to_v519: Use Browser developer-mode and speed improvements as support for Lumen route retries, but keep raw route data private.
Use CLI 0.139.0 web-search and schema improvements to justify read-only sibling research where exposed, without claiming direct sibling tool access when not exposed.
Use MCP framing to keep Lumen, CLI, and app lane route families explicit and non-interchangeable.
Use OWASP guidance to keep agent permissions read-only by default and to require status-only evidence, exposure guards, and no-overclaim gates.
